_readme: These are the defaults. Don't edit this file; create config.json next to it and list only what you change.
config.json is .gitignored and is merged on top of these values (keymap merges per key).
Apply by restarting the web server (start.ps1) and refreshing the browser.
Access control itself is delegated to the network (a private network / Tailscale). What this
guards is only what that can't stop - attacks from the user's own browser: DNS rebinding and cross-origin WebSocket.
allowedHosts: accepted Host headers. A leading '*.' is a wildcard (subdomains).
'*.ts.net' is for Tailscale MagicDNS - an attacker can't own a name under it, so it's safe.
allowedOrigins: WebSocket Origin allowlist. Empty means use the same rule as allowedHosts.
Requests with no Origin at all (curl, scripts) are allowed through - only browsers send Origin.
Format: "chord": "action". Write the chord as Ctrl -> Alt -> Shift, keys lowercase.
The :N after an action is its argument. Run webterm.actions() in the browser console for the full list.
Set a value to "" to stop the app intercepting that chord (it goes to the terminal).
Some chords the browser grabs first and the app can never get: Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Shift+W, Ctrl+Shift+T.
Ctrl+W (delete word) and Ctrl+R (reverse search) are left empty on purpose - PSReadLine uses them.
